import json,sys,collections
sys.path.insert(0,"/opt/alpha-launch/tools/launch"); sys.path.insert(0,"/opt/alpha-launch/tools/registry")
import launch, cellhash_reg
rd = lambda p: {d["hash"]: d for d in map(json.loads, filter(str.strip, open(p, encoding="utf-8")))}
G=rd("/data/tk0268/metrics-G.jsonl"); H=rd("/data/tk0268/metrics-H.jsonl")
old=launch.hash_metrics_file()
L=launch.letopis()
miss=collections.defaultdict(set)
for r in L["rows"]:
    if r["sharpe"] is None and r["winrate"] is None and r["status"]=="full": miss[r["hyp"]].add(r["hash"])
print("G hashes in missing:", {h:sorted(x[:8] for x in s if x in G) for h,s in miss.items() if any(x in G for x in s)})
print("old has G:", sum(1 for h in G if h in old), "of", len(G))
k=next(iter(G.values())); print({a:(str(b)[:150]) for a,b in k.items()})
pnl = collections.defaultdict(dict)
for l in open(launch.REG + "/results.jsonl", encoding="utf-8"):
    if l.strip():
        d = json.loads(l); pnl[d["cell_id"]][d["month"]] = (d.get("pnl_usd"), d.get("trades"))
byh = collections.defaultdict(dict)
for row in cellhash_reg.build():
    for m, v in pnl.get(row[0], {}).items(): byh[row[1]][m] = v
for h in sorted(G):
    if h in old: continue
    print(h[:8], "canon", {m:v for m,v in sorted(byh.get(h,{}).items())}, "| G", str({a:b for a,b in G[h].items() if a in ("months","n","sum_usd","pnl_usd")})[:200])
